volume_definition: Each county actual all-candidate valid votes from named historical contest; no actual-ballot conversion
pair_participation: Each preference anchor county (A+B)/all named candidate votes, held fixed when changing volume mix
other_allocation: Each non-A/B candidate retains their own anchor county share of all-candidate votes; no transfer/lower preference inference
native_model: only directly printed positive A+B within each contest; no cross-year/native crosswalk; all-native whole-state uniform solution unavailable
clipping: clip each A pair share to [0,1] then solve uniform bounded shift by bisection
